title: Batch URL Downloader
description: Paste multiple media URLs, inspect compatible Cove downloaders, detect library duplicates, apply initial metadata tags or groups, and manage a persistent download queue with Skip, Pause, and Finish After Current controls.

blocks.text: Open Paste & Download from the navigation bar to extract HTTP/HTTPS URLs from plain text, Markdown, or chat logs and add them to your persistent download queue.

items: Paste one or more URLs into the Add URLs to Queue box. Duplicate and trailing punctuation are cleaned automatically.
Optionally select a Studio, Group / Series, Tags, or Performers under Initial Metadata Tagging to pre-tag every queued item.
Click Inspect Downloaders to check which installed downloader matches each URL, detect existing library duplicates, and preview available quality options.
Click Queue & Start (or Append to Queue while running/paused) to add the staged URLs to the persistent queue.
Use Pause, Resume, Skip Current (or per-item Skip), and Finish After Current to control the active download queue at any time.

blocks.text: By default, every inspected URL uses Auto (Max Height), which defers to Cove's MaxDownloadHeight setting so your resolution cap is always respected.
If you want to override your global cap for a specific item, pick an explicit stream resolution from its Quality dropdown before queueing.

rows: Extract and match URLs concurrently against installed downloaders
Inspect the persistent download queue state, counters, and items
Append URLs or pre-inspected items to the persistent download queue
Pause queue processing and return the active item to Pending
Resume processing Pending items in the queue
Skip the currently running download and advance to the next item
